title: GenomePatch
description: A typed, itemized change against a base revision (README §6). The schema checks shape only; whether each op applies to its base and stays inside the policy is checked when the patch is recorded (README §6.4).

patch_schema.description: Version of this format; 1 for genome v1.

base.description: The revision this patch is written against; every op must apply to it exactly (README §6.4).

rationale.description: Why the change is proposed, in plain language for the reviewer.

evidence.description: The Experience records that motivated the patch; required unless every op can be motivated by the rationale alone (README §6.4).

op.description: One change. The op field names the kind; oneOf: the object matches exactly one of the op shapes below, the one whose op constant it carries.

content.description: Inline UTF-8 text, or a digest of uploaded bytes. maxLength bounds code points only; the 64 KiB UTF-8 byte limit is checked when the patch is recorded (README §6.4).

unifiedDiff.description: A change to one text file, written as the hunks of a unified diff (the format `diff -u` and `git diff` print), without the ---/+++ file header lines. Each hunk starts with '@@ -<old start>,<old count> +<new start>,<new count> @@'; then each line starts with ' ' (unchanged context), '-' (removed) or '+' (added). Context and removed lines must match the file exactly: no fuzz (README §6.2). Inline text like content: maxLength bounds code points, and the 64 KiB UTF-8 byte limit is checked when the patch is recorded; a larger change is sent as whole-file content by digest.
examples:
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 # Shipping
-Standard shipping takes 3-5 working days.
+Standard shipping takes 2-4 working days.

skillFilePath.description: Relative path inside a skill, as SkillPackageValidator accepts it (any characters, including spaces and non-ASCII), in canonical form: no leading '/', no drive letter, no backslash, no control character, no empty, '.' or '..' segment, no trailing '/'.

textEdit.description: One edit to a text file. oneOf: exactly one of the three kinds, chosen by kind (README §6.2).

kind.description: Replace everything under a Markdown heading; the heading line stays.

heading.description: The heading line, e.g. '## Escalation'; must occur exactly once.

content.description: The new text under the heading.

kind.description: Insert text after an anchor line.

anchor.description: One whole line of the file, which must occur exactly once.

kind.description: Apply a unified diff; expresses any text change.

fileEdit.description: Op file.edit: edits one existing text file in place.

target.description: A persona file, a file inside a skill, a file resource, or a file inside a directory resource.

edits.description: The edits, applied in order to the file.

personaAdd.description: Op persona.add: adds an identity file the bot does not have yet.

content.description: The file's text, which must be valid UTF-8.

personaRemove.description: Op persona.remove: removes an identity file.

skillAdd.description: Op skill.add: adds a local skill from its files.

name.description: The new skill's name; equals the SKILL.md metadata name.

files.description: The skill's files, as a map from path inside the skill to that file's content; it must include SKILL.md. The keys are file paths chosen by the author, not fixed field names, so the map has no `properties` list: `propertyNames` says what a key may be (a skillFilePath), and `additionalProperties` says what every value must be (content: inline text, or {digest} of uploaded bytes for a binary or large file).

examples.SKILL.md:
---
name: invoice-lookup
description: Look up an invoice by order id.
---
Run scripts/lookup.py.

skillUpdate.description: Op skill.update: changes files of an existing local skill, by diffs, by whole-file content, or both (anyOf: at least one of file_diffs and files).

file_diffs.description: Unified diffs to existing text files of the skill; at most one per file, so at most the package's 500 files.

diff.description: The hunks to apply to it.

files.description: Whole-file changes, as a map from path inside the skill to the file's new content (inline text or {digest}), or null to delete that file. Adds a file when the path is new, replaces it when it exists. SKILL.md can be replaced but not deleted: its own entry under `properties` allows only content, while `additionalProperties` (every other path) also allows null.

skillRemove.description: Op skill.remove: removes a skill, local or center.

resourceAdd.description: Op resource.add: adds a file resource, or a directory resource from an uploaded tree. The if/then pair is a conditional rule: if `path` ends in '/' (a directory entry), then `content` must be {digest} of an uploaded acm-tree-v1 blob, because a directory cannot be given as inline text. A file path may use either form of content.

path.description: Where the resource goes in the workspace; ends in '/' for a directory.

content.description: The file's content, or the uploaded acm-tree-v1 blob for a directory.
A directory resource is added from an uploaded acm-tree-v1 blob.

resourceRemove.description: Op resource.remove: removes a resource entry.

path.description: The entry to remove, as declared.

memoryAdd.description: Op memory.add: adds a curated memory item with a new key.

memoryUpdate.description: Op memory.update: replaces the text, tags and source of an existing item, by key; the item stays, with new content. Compare memory.retire, which removes the item.

item.description: The item's new value; its key names the item to replace.

memoryRetire.description: Op memory.retire: removes a curated memory item, by key; earlier revisions keep it. Compare memory.update, which keeps the item and changes its content.

memorySetMode.description: Op memory.set_mode: changes how apply writes the curated items into the engine's memory.

mode.description: The new mode (see memorySpec.mode in the revision schema); replace is T3.
